decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9901 Rev P01 (received 25/04/2013)
021-PE-BF-ZZ-DR-A-1304 Rev C01, 021-PE-BF-ZZ-DR-A-1305 Rev C02, 021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9907 Rev C01, 021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9908 Rev C01 (received 08/07/2013)
021-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-1306 Rev P01 (received 10/07/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - Prior to the 31st October 2014 the buildings and access ramp hereby approved shall be removed from the site and the ground returned to its former condition.
description: Demolition of two classroom buildings, installation of two temporary buildings for use as classrooms and offices and installation of temporary access ramp to the front of the site.
